emscripten.purpose: builds libs/jolt/wasm/jolt.wasm and libs/box2d/wasm/box2d.wasm (tools/gen_jolt.py, tools/gen_box2d.py, which refuse another release) and raylib's C programs for the page in tools/gen_speed.py; found at HELIX_EMSDK or EMSDK or ~/toolchains/emsdk, never fetched, and not needed to build or test a program, as the modules are committed

nativeSystemLibraries.ALSA: 1.2.11 (system development/runtime library on measured Linux host)

sdl3Mixer.license: zlib; stb_vorbis and dr_libs public domain or MIT

vendored.files: include/SDL3_mixer/SDL_mixer.h, LICENSE.txt, and from src/: SDL_mixer.c, SDL_mixer_internal.h, SDL_mixer_metadata_tags.c, SDL_mixer_spatialization.c, the raw, sinewave, wav, stb_vorbis, drmp3 and drflac decoders, stb_vorbis/ and dr_libs/
vendored.built: with the program by hxcpp (Sdl3MixerBridge), defining DECODER_WAV, DECODER_OGGVORBIS_STB, DECODER_MP3_DRMP3 and DECODER_FLAC_DRFLAC

stbImage.source: https://github.com/nothings/stb (master, identical to the v2.30 header)
stbImage.license: public domain or MIT, at the end of the header

stbTruetype.source: https://github.com/nothings/stb (master, identical to the v1.26 header, which raylib 5.5 vendors too)
stbTruetype.license: public domain or MIT, at the end of the header

gpuShaders.purpose: glslang and SPIRV-Cross, which helix-platform's shader compiler runs (glslang compiles GLSL to SPIR-V; SPIRV-Cross translates it to every other dialect and reflects it)
gpuShaders.pinned: in libs/platform/src/helix/platform/tools/ShaderTools.hx, so the compiler finds them wherever helix-platform is installed: glslang 16.6.0's official releases, SPIRV-Cross's vulkan-sdk-1.4.363.0 source

speed.purpose: tools/gen_speed.py, which measures helix-raylib against the others (docs/benchmarks.md); the toolchains are found, never fetched: Emscripten at EMSDK or HELIX_EMSDK or ~/toolchains/emsdk, Godot at HELIX_GODOT or on PATH or ~/toolchains/godot, helix-legacy at HELIX_LEGACY or ../helix-legacy, three.js, esbuild and Electron installed with npm into build/speed/three/npm
speed.raylib: 5.5 (tools/test_raylib_parity.py's pinned release: its C programs, its web library, and the assets, wabbit_alpha.png and robot.glb)

vendored.built: natively with the program by hxcpp (files.xml), and into libs/jolt/wasm/jolt.wasm by Emscripten (tools/gen_jolt.py)

vendored.files: src/'s .c, .h and .inl files, include/box2d/'s headers, api/box2d_api.json and LICENSE
vendored.built: natively with the program by hxcpp (files.xml), and into libs/box2d/wasm/box2d.wasm by Emscripten (tools/gen_box2d.py)
